items.q: Do customers need to install an app?
items.a: No. They scan the QR code with the phone camera and a web page opens showing their order.

items.q: What if the phone is locked?
items.a: Today the customer keeps the page open: the phone plays a sound, vibrates and the screen turns green when the order is ready. We are working on alerts that reach a locked screen.
No. Each branch has a secret link that the cashier opens on any device. You can replace it at any time.
{monthly} JD per month with the first month free, or {yearly} JD per year.

items.q: Can I use it for several branches?
items.a: Yes. One account holds several branches, each with its own QR code and statistics.

items.q: Can the order numbers match my invoices?
items.a: Yes. The cashier can type an invoice number and the app continues counting from it.
